account.title: Account & settings
account.description: Who you are in the console, how you sign in, and what the platform sends you.
account.nav.label: Account sections
account.status.error: Nothing was saved — check the fields and try again.
profile.heading: Who you are
profile.hint: The name other editors see next to the records you change.
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHint: Shown in the console and in the history of every edit you make.
profile.emailHint: This address is the account itself. A platform administrator changes it.
password.hint: A password is an alternative to the secure link, never a replacement for the second factor.
security.heading: How you sign in
security.hint: Both ways stay available; this is the one the sign-in page offers first.
security.methodHint: Secure links need nothing to remember. A password works when your inbox is slow.
security.twoFactor.heading: Second factor
security.twoFactor.hint: After the email link or the password, a short SMS code confirms it is you.
security.twoFactor.noRecipient: No number is enrolled yet: add one below to receive codes.
security.twoFactor.locked: Your role requires the second factor
security.twoFactor.lockedHint: Roles that reach other people’s accounts and work always confirm an SMS code, so this stays on.
security.error.twoFactorRequired: Your role requires the second factor, so it cannot be turned off.
security.phone.heading: The number that receives codes
security.phone.hint: Enrolled with your account, used for signing in and security alerts, never shown on the public site.
security.phone.label: Mobile number
security.phone.labelHint: International format, country code included. For example: +33 6 12 34 56 78.
security.phone.pending: This number is waiting to be confirmed
security.phone.pendingHint: Codes only really go there once the first one has been entered.
preferences.heading: Interface
preferences.hint: How the console looks and reads for you, on every device you sign in from.
preferences.languageHint: Content keeps its own languages; this is the console's.
preferences.themeHint: Applies here straight away, and is remembered on this device.
preferences.densityHint: Compact fits more rows on screen at once.
preferences.time.heading: Dates and times
preferences.time.hint: Opening hours, review dates and quiet hours are read in this zone.
preferences.timeZoneHint: Search by city — for example Europe/Paris.
preferences.comfort.heading: Comfort
preferences.comfort.hint: Two settings for reading the console in a hurry, or on a hard screen.
preferences.reducedMotionHint: Panels and menus appear without movement.
preferences.highContrastHint: Stronger borders and text against the background.
notify.heading: What reaches you
notify.hint: One line per thing that can happen, and where you want to hear about it.
notify.kind.activity_review_due: An activity is due for review
notify.kind.activity_status_changed: An activity opens, closes or changes status
notify.kind.publication_state: A record is published or unpublished
notify.kind.translation_assignment: A translation is assigned to you
notify.kind.membership_invitation: You are invited to an organisation
notify.kind.coordination_event: A coordination meeting is added or moved
notify.rhythm.heading: Rhythm
notify.rhythm.hint: How often the summary arrives, and when the platform stays quiet.
notify.digestHint: Everything waiting on you, in one message.
notify.quietHint: Set both ends, or neither. Account security messages are always delivered.
security.error.setupFailed: Setup could not be started. Try again shortly.
security.error.invalidCode: That code is incorrect or expired. Ask for another if you need one.
security.error.phone: That number cannot be read. Write it in international format, for example +33 6 12 34 56 78.
security.error.sendError: The SMS could not be sent. Try again shortly.
security.error.rateLimited: Too many codes were requested. Try again shortly.
security.status.twoFactorEnabled: Two-factor authentication is on for this account.
security.status.codeSent: The code was sent. It can only be used once.
security.twoFactor.mandateTitle: Your role requires a second check
security.twoFactor.mandateHint: Your role opens up accounts, coordination data, and published content. Set up an authenticator app or enrol a mobile number to continue.
security.totp.heading: Authenticator app
security.totp.hint: Scan this code with your app, then enter the six digits it shows. Nothing is switched on until you confirm.
security.totp.secretLabel: Key to type in by hand
security.totp.secretHint: Use this if you cannot scan the code.
security.backup.heading: Backup codes
security.backup.warnHint: They will not be shown again. Each one works only once, and they are what gets you in if you lose your phone.
security.twoFactor.passwordHint: Needed to turn two-factor authentication on or off, or to renew its codes.
security.error.password: The current password is incorrect or missing.
security.sessions.heading: Signed-in devices
security.sessions.hint: Every device where your account is open. If you do not recognise one, sign it out.
security.sessions.signOutAll: Sign out every device, including this one
security.status.othersSignedOut: The other devices were signed out.
security.status.devicesForgotten: That device will be asked for a code again.
security.trustedDevices.heading: Devices that skip the code
security.trustedDevices.hint: Devices you have trusted. They sign in without an SMS or authenticator code until the date shown, then ask again.
security.trustedDevices.empty: No device is trusted. Every sign-in asks for a code. You can trust one when you next enter a code.
